falas: Day one. Frieren says we have a long road ahead. The walk to the next town takes three days.
Three days? And she calls that short.
For her, it is. She waited fifty years to see the meteors with her old friends.
Fifty years. My village is only twenty years old!
Tonight we stop at an inn. We sleep for eight hours, and then we walk again.
Eisen trained me for five years. Five long years.
The old party traveled for ten years. Now we walk the same road.
And the trip north takes two months on foot.
Two months. Then she can talk to Himmel one more time.
